page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-4-lssd is an x86_64 virtual server from the Network Optimized family. The configuration includes 4 dedicated vCPUs and 15.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware resources are accompanied by a bundled 403 GB local NVMe solid-state drive, providing direct high-throughput storage capacity without requiring additional network storage attachments for basic operation. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

The inclusion of a 403 GB local NVMe SSD makes this instance suitable for operations constrained by disk I/O latency. Because vCPU allocation is dedicated rather than burstable or shared, processing output remains consistent across sustained compute cycles. Resource efficiency is achieved by pairing a balanced memory-to-core configuration with integrated high-speed local disk space. Architectural considerations include the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires explicit networking provisioning for external connectivity.

This server profile matches workloads demanding reliable core performance alongside fast local disk scratch space. Primary workload fits include transactional database operations, local caching layers, intermediate extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines, and internal web application backends.
